title: Knowledge atom
description: One piece of an expert's knowledge. Channel-neutral: it names no platform, model or audience. Adapters turn atoms into Hatch lessons, Claude agents, prompt packs and the like.

statement.description: The claim, in the expert's own words where possible.

why.description: The reason behind it. Optional in the file, but the quality benchmark requires it on most confirmed atoms.

unless.description: When the rule fails or does not apply.

example.description: The story or evidence behind it.

domain.description: Areas of the expert's field, e.g. testing, database, security, ux.

applies_to.description: Words in a piece of work that make this relevant. Empty means it applies broadly.

legacy.description: Ids in older stores this came from, e.g. Hatch lesson ids.

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. interview date.

ext.description: Channel-specific data kept so a store can round-trip, namespaced by channel, e.g. ext.hatch = {for, detail, added}. Atoms never depend on it.
